title: Dedicated least-privilege administrators
assertion: Privileged work uses identifiable dedicated admin accounts; routine work and delegated tasks avoid super-admin privilege.
evidence_to_collect: Role roster and task-to-role review covering all administrators.
review_gate: Record the owner of each privileged role; test delegation before removing access.

title: Phishing-resistant admin sign-in
assertion: Administrators use enforced security-key/passkey-capable sign-in with tested spare credentials.
evidence_to_collect: Effective 2SV method policy and successful administrator sign-in tests.
review_gate: Complete enrollment and recovery testing before stricter method enforcement.

title: Independent administrator recovery
assertion: At least two separately accountable super administrators have tested recovery routes and securely stored spare credentials.
evidence_to_collect: Private recovery exercise record, custodians, and dependencies.
review_gate: Do not copy shared emergency-account assumptions from another identity provider.

title: Workforce 2SV enforcement
assertion: Every in-scope workforce account is covered by the approved 2SV policy, with enrollment verified and temporary exceptions recorded.
evidence_to_collect: Effective OU/group policies plus enrollment and real sign-in evidence.
review_gate: Group precedence and report lag can hide gaps; agree onboarding grace and recovery method.

title: Controlled external collaboration
assertion: Confidential firm/deal content is shared only through approved authenticated collaboration scopes; broad external links are restricted.
evidence_to_collect: OU/group settings and allowed/denied sharing tests using synthetic files.
review_gate: Map investor, portfolio, counsel, and administrator collaboration before tightening access.

title: Guest and external permission review
assertion: An owner reviews external people and item permissions; access is removed when the collaboration ends.
evidence_to_collect: Dated permission review and a removal test for shared-drive and individually shared content.
review_gate: Blocking sharing can leave permissions in place; re-enabling can restore access.

title: App access review
assertion: OAuth apps have an approved owner, purpose, data scope, and access decision; unknown high-access apps are investigated.
evidence_to_collect: API controls inventory and review of OAuth scopes and effective access decisions.
review_gate: A trusted publisher or app label does not establish a business need.

title: Narrow domain-wide delegation
assertion: Every domain-wide delegation grant has an essential business case, narrow scopes, controlled credentials, and a review date.
evidence_to_collect: Grant inventory, scope review, service-account ownership and key-management record.
review_gate: Do not grant domain-wide delegation merely to collect this assessment.

title: Managed endpoint requirements
assertion: Device owners have an approved platform-specific enrollment, encryption, screen-lock, supported-OS, and lost-device response standard with evidence of coverage.
evidence_to_collect: Device inventory, management capability map, exception list, and synthetic lost-device tabletop.
review_gate: Basic and advanced management differ; identify a separate endpoint tool where needed.

title: Context-aware access coverage
assertion: Licensed in-scope users accessing selected sensitive apps are covered by tested context-aware access requirements.
evidence_to_collect: License-by-user coverage, access-level assignments, browser/platform and denied-access tests.
review_gate: Unsupported editions do not enforce these policies; service-account/API and app coverage require separate review.

title: SPF sender inventory
assertion: Each sending domain has a validated SPF record covering all authorized senders without duplicate SPF records or invalid lookup expansion.
evidence_to_collect: DNS record and sender inventory, with message-header tests for each sender class.
review_gate: Include investor communications, CRM, finance, ticketing, and marketing before DNS changes.

title: DKIM signing
assertion: All in-scope sending domains and services use validated DKIM signing with documented key ownership.
evidence_to_collect: Published key, enabled signing status, and received-message signature test.
review_gate: Use the actual vendor-generated key/selector; never copy example DNS values.

title: DMARC enforcement plan
assertion: A domain owner has validated alignment and reporting, completed sender remediation, and approved an enforced DMARC policy for in-scope domains.
evidence_to_collect: Policy record, representative aligned headers, report review and change approval.
review_gate: Monitoring-only is a rollout stage; move toward enforcement after legitimate traffic is understood.

title: Audit coverage and retention
assertion: Required audit sources, lag, retention, export path, access owners, and retrieval tests are documented for the actual edition.
evidence_to_collect: A source-by-source matrix and successful retrieval of a synthetic event.
review_gate: Native log windows vary; export before expiry if the approved need is longer.

title: Actionable admin alerts
assertion: Administrative/security alert types have an owner, escalation route, and a completed delivery-and-response test.
evidence_to_collect: Alert routing settings and dated response exercise.
review_gate: Verify the route remains reachable during primary account or mail-service failure.

title: Reviewed retention and holds
assertion: A records owner has approved data-type retention and hold requirements, and verified effective Vault coverage or a documented alternative.
evidence_to_collect: Approved schedule, licensed population, rules/hold review and scoped retrieval test.
review_gate: Vault needs applicable licenses and configured rules; deletion/license removal can affect retained data.

title: Tested business recovery
assertion: Critical mail and document workloads have agreed recovery objectives, a coverage map, and a restore exercise that verifies content and permissions.
evidence_to_collect: Recovery method per workload, measured restore result, missing-data/permission findings.
review_gate: Native recovery windows and Vault exports do not establish end-to-end business recovery.

title: Controlled identity rollout
assertion: Identity and access changes have a pilot, enrollment check, business tests, recovery route, and saved previous configuration.
evidence_to_collect: Approved change record and pilot test results.
review_gate: Use actual product capabilities; do not assume every Google setting has report-only mode.

title: Durable document ownership
assertion: Critical operating records use accountable shared ownership with reviewed membership and continuity when a staff member leaves.
evidence_to_collect: Critical repository map and ownership/permission continuity test.
review_gate: Shared-drive availability and supported behavior depend on edition and chosen structure.

title: Offboarding access and records
assertion: A tested leaver process suspends relevant access, addresses delegated/third-party access, and preserves records under the approved schedule.
evidence_to_collect: Synthetic leaver exercise with identity, applications, ownership, retention, and verification checkpoints.
review_gate: Suspension is one step; do not equate account deletion with a complete leaver process.

title: Generative AI access and data boundaries
assertion: Gemini app and Gemini features in Workspace services are enabled only for approved populations, Gemini access to Workspace data is a recorded decision, and retention coverage for Gemini app conversations is confirmed or a documented alternative exists.
evidence_to_collect: Effective OU/group service status for the Gemini app and per-service Gemini features, the Workspace-data access decision, the conversation-history setting, and a Vault rule or hold review for Gemini app data.
review_gate: Turning Gemini off in one service does not stop Gemini in another service from reading that data; decide the data boundary before the feature rollout.

title: Sensitive-content rules for Drive and Chat
assertion: In-scope Drive and Chat content is covered by tested DLP rules for the approved sensitive data categories, with an agreed audit-only, warn, or block action and a reviewed rule log.
evidence_to_collect: Rule inventory with detectors, triggers, and actions; supported-edition confirmation by population; synthetic-content trigger test and the resulting rule log event.
review_gate: DLP for Drive and Chat is edition-limited; start in audit-only mode and review rule log events before enabling warn or block.

title: Managed browser policy
assertion: Chrome used for Workspace runs under user-level or enrolled-browser policies covering extension control, sign-in restrictions, and security settings, with enrollment coverage evidenced and unmanaged browsers recorded as exceptions.
evidence_to_collect: Chrome policy export by OU, managed-browser or signed-in-profile coverage report, extension allow/block list, and a denied-extension test.
review_gate: User policies follow the signed-in managed profile and enrolled-browser policies follow the device; decide which applies to personal devices before enforcement.

title: Script and low-code governance
assertion: Apps Script and AppSheet availability and external-sharing settings are recorded decisions, internal scripts and apps with broad scopes appear in the app-access inventory, and external connections are allowlisted where the edition supports it.
evidence_to_collect: Apps Script and AppSheet service status by OU, internal-app entries in API controls, the external-URL allowlist or a documented gap, and an owner for each production script.
review_gate: AppSheet Core settings apply organization-wide and turning Apps Script off blocks execution; inventory installed triggers and shared apps before restricting.
